It means we've never needed anyone's permission to build for the next decade instead of the next funding round. We answer to the small businesses that use Close. 2012 A sales team for hire. Close's founders started ElasticSales after completing Y Combinator, running outbound sales for venture-backed Silicon Valley startups. 2013 We built the CRM we wanted to use. Frustrated that nothing on the market actually helped reps sell, our team spent 18 months building our own internal tool. We launched Close: a conversation-first CRM built by salespeople, for salespeople. 2014–2017 We built communication into the CRM. Built-in calling and email were core to Close from our public launch in 2013, and native SMS came soon after. We were building a CRM that improved how reps communicate, not just a system that tracks it. 2018 We automated repetitive tasks with Workflows. Our automated sequences took manual admin off reps' plates, so selling time stayed selling time. 2025 Chloe and AI Agents joined the team. We introduced Chloe, our AI voice agent, and started building AI Agents that take action across the sales process on your behalf. 2026 11,500+ customers and growing. We're entering an era of rapid product expansion, fueled by AI and focused on SMBs. Our product has changed dramatically over 13+ years. Our beliefs haven't: your CRM should help you sell, not create more work for you. Learn about the Close team What to expect in the Close hiring process We care deeply about the candidate experience, so each interview flow may vary depending on the role. We strive to provide an environment that respects the time and energy of both our candidates and internal team. Application Review Our application process promotes equitable and unbiased hiring practices. We ask a short series of questions, similar to what you would be asked in the first interview. This helps us learn more about you right from the start, so please be sure to answer each question thoughtfully. All applications are reviewed by a team member; qualified applications undergo secondary review. Regardless of fit, we will let you know if you're moving forward. Video Intro Call You'll first meet with the hiring manager or People Operations team. We seek to understand you, your background, professional goals, and what’s important to you when choosing your next position and company. This call is an opportunity for you to ask questions about the role, company, culture, values, or product. Skills Assessment This is a hypothetical prompt designed to resemble key aspects of this role's responsibilities. Each take-home project is thoughtfully designed by the hiring manager to include a grading system, concise directions, and clear goals. These projects may take between 3-6 hours to complete depending on the role. However, we never use your work product. Video Interviews After the skills assessment, we'll dive into your technical skills during 1 to 2 interviews hosted by your potential colleagues. This step focuses on the specifics of the role and provides you an opportunity to ask the team about their experiences at Close. Video Interview with Founder Interviews conclude with a 1:1, 30-minute call with one of our Co-Founders or VP of Engineering. These are typically honest conversations that allow you the opportunity to discuss any outstanding questions. Our founders are active leaders at Close and genuinely interested in every person who joins the team. Reference Checks We’ll ask you to provide three references who can speak to your professional experience––ideally at least one of whom you've reported to. These calls help us validate what we already believe to be true based on our interviews with you. Got a referral? Introduce us to someone in your network who would be a great fit for one of our open roles. We’ll send you a $1,000 referral bonus for successful hires.
